name: 墨勒
src: 月银纪史诗/第十四歌_藏命之匣.md:177
who: Mele, a human prince and hunter of the east city on the plains, twenty: about 183 cm, slender and strong, a man who can run a whole day behind a deer. Short hair of deep red verging on brown, like burnt firewood, one lock sticking up over the forehead; amber eyes that burn bright when he sights prey. A handsome, keen face with a clean jaw and a boyish grin. Fair skin. A small old burn mark on the back of his LEFT hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us). A bold, cheerful, restless air.
build: 183 cm, slender and strong: long legs, wiry arms, a runner's chest.
palette: burnt-wood red-brown and amber, iron-wolf grey, white ash wood, a little cream
casual: His plains hunter's clothes: a leather hunting jerkin over a short-sleeved tunic, leather leggings and boots, a heavy grey pelt of the iron-skinned wolf king worn as a mantle across the shoulders. He holds a white ash-wood hunting spear upright at his side, its head ground by his own hand. A bold grin.
private: Off duty: a loose undyed linen shirt with the collar open and sleeves rolled, brown wool trousers and soft boots. He stands easy with a thumb hooked in his belt, a boyish grin.
battle: Ready to throw: the hunting jerkin laced tight, leather bracers, the wolf pelt over one shoulder, a small cypress-wood box tied tightly at his belt. He grips the white ash spear in his right hand drawn back at shoulder height, the left arm forward for balance, eyes locked ahead.
formal: For the king's hall: a deep red wool tunic to the knee with a gold-edged collar, a dark belt, the wolf pelt worn folded over one shoulder, polished boots. He stands upright, one hand on the spear shaft at his side, a proud half-smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the amber eyes bright and fixed on something past the viewer, a boyish grin. Warm firelight from one side on the red-brown hair. Foreground blur: falling sparks and a few rain streaks. He wears the grey wolf pelt over the hunting jerkin.

name: 欧德
src: 月银纪史诗/第十四歌_藏命之匣.md:233
who: Ode, a human boy of fifteen who keeps the fire at the east gate of the plains city, a younger version of this person: about 158 cm, thin and small-framed. Tousled ash-grey-brown hair that looks dusted with ash, dark coal-red eyes that look at people without ever dropping away. A thin, childlike face with a streak of black soot across the cheekbone; small healed burn scars on his hands. Fair skin. Unlike the older man in the last attached picture, he is a boy: his hair is ash grey-brown, NOT white, and his face is smooth and young with no wrinkles. A quiet, stubborn, steady air.
palette: ash grey-brown and ember red, old burnt leather brown, soot black
casual: His fire-keeper's clothes: an old hide cloak burned through with several holes, over a coarse undyed wool tunic and trousers, worn boots; an iron fire-tongs and a small leather tinder pouch at his belt. He stands plain and steady, looking straight ahead.
private: Off duty: a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt and plain trousers, soft hide shoes, the hide cloak left off. He stands quietly holding the iron fire-tongs in both hands in front of him.
battle: Standing his ground: the burned hide cloak belted tight with a cord, the tinder pouch at his belt, boots wrapped with thongs. He holds the iron fire-tongs upright in both hands in front of him like a staff, the feet planted, the chin raised; a stubborn look.
battle_pose: 3) the fire-keeper's stand, since he does not fight and carries no weapon: braced and steady, the shoulders set, the feet a little wider and planted, the chin up, holding the iron fire-tongs upright in both hands.
formal: For a feast day: the same hide cloak brushed clean of soot, over a clean undyed wool tunic, the tongs hung at his belt. He stands upright with the hands folded in front, a quiet, serious look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the coal-red eyes looking straight at the viewer, the mouth closed, a serious steady look. Warm firelight from one side on the soot-streaked cheek, cold blue dusk on the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks.

name: 伊莱娜
src: 月银纪史诗/第十四歌_藏命之匣.md:288
who: Irena, a human queen of the east city on the plains, forty-two: about 165 cm, thin from sleepless nights but standing very upright. Long wine-red hair pinned up at the back of her head, with one white streak at the temple (on the viewer's left when she faces us). Amber eyes like her son's, with bluish shadows beneath them. A dignified, finely made face still showing the beauty of the best-looking queen of the plains. Fair skin. The palm of her RIGHT hand is marked red, and she keeps it hidden in her long sleeve. A tired, composed, guarded air.
build: 165 cm, slender, thinner than she should be: a medium bust, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: wine red and amber, deep brown, wheat gold, a little ash white
casual: Her queen's dress: a long deep-brown wool gown with a band of embroidered wheat ears around the hem, long sleeves that cover her hands, a bunch of keys on an iron ring at her belt. She stands straight with the right hand hidden in its sleeve and the left hand resting on the keys.
private: Off duty: a long-sleeved soft undyed wool gown in muted brown, a knitted grey shawl over the shoulders, the hair loosely pinned. She stands with the hands hidden in the sleeves, a tired, quiet look.
battle: Standing firm for her house: the deep-brown gown with a leather belt cinched tight, a heavy dark travelling cloak, the key ring held firmly in her left hand, the right hand hidden in its sleeve; the chin raised, the brows drawn together.
battle_pose: 3) the queen's stand, since she does not fight: upright and unyielding, the shoulders squared, the feet together, the chin raised, one hand closed tightly on the iron key ring, the other hidden in the sleeve.
formal: For the king's hall: a long straight deep-brown wool gown with a wide hem band of embroidered gold wheat ears that shimmer like ripening grain when she moves, long sleeves that hide her hands, a pale shawl pinned with a heavy bronze brooch, the key ring at her belt, a thin gold circlet. She stands very upright with the hands hidden in the sleeves in front.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the amber eyes tired but steady, looking at the viewer with a composed, guarded look, the lips closed. Warm hearth firelight from one side on the white streak at her temple. Foreground blur: a few drifting sparks and the edge of an iron key ring.

name: 嘉琳
src: 月银纪史诗/第十四歌_藏命之匣.md:344
who: Jarlin, a human young hunter of the southern grain plains, a younger version of this person: nineteen, about 170 cm, slender and long-legged, restless, always standing with one foot pointed on its toe as if about to run. Short wheat-gold hair cut ragged by her own hunting knife. Pale amber eyes like dried wheat straw that never blink when she looks into the distance. Fair skin that reddens in the sun, with freckles over a straight nose. Unlike the older woman in the last attached picture, she is young: her hair is full wheat-gold with no white, and her face is smooth, with no lines. A free, quick, bold air.
build: 170 cm, slender and long-legged: lithe, athletic shoulders, a small bust, a narrow waist and light hips.
palette: wheat gold and straw, pale amber, worn hide brown, faded green
casual: Her grain-plains hunter's clothes: a short hunting jerkin over a close-fitting long-sleeved shirt, tight leg wraps and soft boots with worn soles; a short bow slung across her back with a quiver of arrows, a small pouch of wheat grains at her belt. She stands with one foot pointed on its toe, a bold half-smile.
private: Off duty: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves pushed up, plain brown trousers and soft shoes, the short hair tousled. She stands easy, a few grains of wheat in her hand.
battle: Ready to shoot: the jerkin laced tight, a leather bracer on the left forearm. She holds the short bow drawn with an arrow nocked, eyes fixed on the distance, one foot pointed back on its toe; a sharp, unblinking look.
formal: For a feast: a clean brown wool tunic and trousers, a wheat-gold sash, a few wheat ears pinned at the chest, the short bow slung over the shoulder. She stands upright with her hands behind her back, an awkward polite smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the pale amber eyes looking far away and then straight at the viewer, a bold half-smile. Low gold evening light from one side on the ragged wheat-gold hair. Foreground blur: tall wheat ears bending in the wind.
art_extra: Her skin stays fair and pale in this portrait, the same light complexion as the full-body sheet; the gold evening light only warms the lit edge of the face and does not tan or darken her skin.
